roof_planes.name: Main south slope with dormer opening

east_stair.basis: Owner green outline: approach along Terrace 2, quarter-turn winders, then ascend westwards to the east upper terrace. Concept dimensions; 19 risers resolve the actual floor rise.

plan_trace_basis: Owner revision extends the north eave and west gable to the wooden-floor edges, leaves 1m on the east and retains the blue ridge at local X=3.95m. Ridge crest exactly 5m above the floor.
room_basis: Approved south shed dormer retained; matching glazed doors added to east and west gables. Room size, cladding and glazing layout are concept choices.
